purpose: Teach: プロレタリアート/ユニバーサル/中日/ヘクタール/コンプレックス/アンチ/電脳/乙女

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、プロレタリアート運動を装った急進派を、警察、警戒されますね
lines.en: So in this case, the police must be keeping watch on radical groups pretending to represent the proletarian movement.
lines.style: Careful, methodical cadence. Intellectually engaged but hesitant—testing an idea aloud. Slightly formal register. Pause after 'case' as if reviewing notes mentally.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ユニバーサル仕様の現場用品を整備されますね
lines.en: Yes, the police have standardized equipment ready for field operations.
lines.style: Measured, professional affirmation. Even-keeled, cooperative tone. Not defensive—simply factual. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、中日外交絡みのスパイ事案を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: And this case likely involves espionage tied to Sino-Japanese diplomatic relations that the police are handling.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Connecting dots quietly. Academic precision. Slightly lower volume, as if reasoning through something sensitive.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、農地ヘクタール表記の改ざんも捜査されますね
lines.en: The police are also investigating the falsification of hectare measurements on agricultural land.
lines.style: Steady, unflinching delivery. Practical matter-of-factness. No surprise in the voice—this is routine work. Direct eye contact level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者のコンプレックスを、警察、心理分析されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police must be conducting psychological analysis of the suspect's complexes.
lines.style: Careful, almost clinical tone. Intellectual interest mixed with restraint. Slower pace on the technical language. Slight formality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、過激なアンチ団体の動向も追われますね
lines.en: The police are tracking the movements of these radical anti-groups as well.
lines.style: Calm, competent assurance. No strain in the voice. Listing facts as part of standard procedure. Steady, reassuring.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、電脳空間での犯罪を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: And crimes in cyberspace—the police are investigating those too in this case.
lines.style: Measured continuation. Slightly increased precision on technical terms. Not exhausted, but systematic. Adding to the list.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、乙女を装った詐欺事案も担当されますね
lines.en: The police handle fraud cases where the perpetrator impersonates a woman as well.
lines.style: Quiet precision. Slight weariness—acknowledging the breadth of cases. Not judgmental, just factual. Warm but tired.
